main_text.l: Illustrissimis & Potentissimis ORDINIBUS GENERALIBUS Belgij confœderati.
Illustrissimo Principi MAURITIO DE NASSAU PRINCIPI AURANTIÆ, COMITI NASSAVIÆ, &c. Gubernatori Confœderati Belgij, Expeditionum maritimarum Præfecto.
REI quam tracto pondus ILLUSTRISSIMI ORDI-NES, ILLUSTRISSIME PRIN-CEPS, AMPLISSIMI DOMINI,

page.notes: Long s is printed as s and has been normalised to s. The ligatures in "tracto" and "confœderati" are as printed. The shape of the "œ" in "confœderati" is slightly doubtful. The printed "* 2" at the foot is read as a signature mark. The catchword "me" is read from the right of the foot line. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
